Two identical rules with all six criteria ANDed; page gives one 'boil/abscess likely' conclusion and cross-references p83. Requiring discharge and fluctuance together may miss early lesions.
Generic 'Skin nodule' and 'Pustule' alone trigger probable acne, overly sensitive relative to the page's red papules/pustules/nodules/blackheads on face/trunk.

Mole check_for entry 'Melanocytic nevus' is placed in a task triggered by mass of skin, so a mole is listed as a finding to check; and no 'check_for' covers lipoma 'Soft ... Painless' mobility or molluscum skin-coloured.

Both use Mass of subcutaneous tissue with overlapping Smooth/Well defined/Painless qualifiers and require both ANDed clinical_finding lines, effectively duplicating the same finding with different qualifier sets.

summary: Mole referral criterion 'differs from surrounding moles' is missing and size-change is covered only by a generic change concept. Diagnosis rules capture main descriptors but drop skin-coloured/pearly (molluscum) and doughy/mobile (lipoma), and acne triggers on very generic pustule/nodule findings.
